confirmed: Source confirms the bubble and RESCUE chain proposed from the first-pass packet as the mandatory both-exit route.
missed_mechanics: Pac deliberately enables the bubble; Isp must take FLOAT while Pac avoids STICKY.
incorrect_inferences: The first-pass warning treated the tall barriers as possible hazards; they are nonlethal hero-specific gates.
changed_judgments: Timing is a repeatable bubble cycle (1), hazards are absent (0), and a missed ascent costs a retry (2); these follow the source effects, not the scores alone.
unresolved: No human pair was observed; first-time discovery, actual coordination friction, and success distribution remain unknown.

single_operator_note: One operator must keep Pac on BUBBLES while steering Isp in FLOAT; two humans can each own one control set.
